title: fix(runner): validate workflow outputs shape before running prerequisites or steps

raw.title: fix(runner): validate workflow outputs shape before running prerequisites or steps
raw.body:
## Problem

A malformed workflow-level `outputs` was only discovered at the very end of a run — once `OutputResolver.resolve` was finally reached from `WorkflowExecutor#result` — after every prerequisite and step had already fired its live requests.

## Fix

`WorkflowExecutor` already validates a malformed `steps` up front, before any prerequisite runs, on the stated reasoning that an authoring error deserves to be caught before side effects rather than after. A malformed `outputs` is the same kind of authoring error: the workflow can never produce it, so it's unrunnable from the start.

This adds a private `#validateWorkflowOutputsShape`, checked alongside `#orderedSteps` before dependencies or steps run. It throws the same `ResolverError` (`reason: 'malformed-outputs'`) `OutputResolver.resolve` already throws, so behavior is unchanged except for *when* it's caught.

The check is intentionally duplicated in `WorkflowExecutor` rather than exposed as new public API on `OutputResolver` — `OutputResolver.resolve` is the meaningful public operation; a standalone `validateShape` would just be a guard clause reachable from outside, unlike e.g. `StepExecutor.evaluateCriteria`/`selectActions`, which are genuinely meaningful on their own.

Step-level `outputs` is left as-is (not pre-flighted): its blast radius is one step, not a whole run — the issue itself frames that as the weaker case.

## Testing

- New fixture workflow `malformedOutputsWithDependency` (bad `outputs`, plus a `dependsOn` and its own step).
- New spec asserting `reason: 'malformed-outputs'` and zero HTTP calls before the throw — the crux of the issue.
- `npm run build`, `npm run lint`, `npm run test` all green (492 passing).

Closes #53
